title: Linearity of the integration
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum
and the coefficient
conventions, $A=A_{E,n}$, $s=\Spec k$, and let $\beta$ be
separated finite type
and proper over $s$
with exceptionally admissible
structure morphism $a_\beta:\beta\to s$. Then the integration
$\int_\beta$ of [def-trf-integration] is $A$-linear: for
$\tau,\tau'\in\Hom_{D(\beta,A)}(A_\beta,\omega_{\beta,A})$ and
$a\in A$,

$$
\int_\beta(\tau+a\tau')=\int_\beta(\tau)+a\int_\beta(\tau').
$$

proof.text: Write $F=R\Gamma_c(\beta,-)$. By [def-trf-integration], properness identifies the cohomology functor in the defining composite with $F=R\Gamma(s,Ra_{\beta!}-)$. Here $R\Gamma(s,-)$ on $D^b_c(s,A)$ is $\operatorname{Fib}_s$: by [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], evaluation at the geometric point of $s$ is the exact sections functor $\Gamma(s,-)$ applied termwise, so $R\Gamma(s,Ra_{\beta!}-)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{\beta!}-)=R\Gamma_c(\beta,-)$. There are fixed arrows $u:A\to F(A_\beta)$ and $v:F(\omega_{\beta,A})\to A$, independent of $\tau$, and the integration is the scalar represented by $v\circ F(\tau)\circ u$. Here $u$ is the image of the ordinary pullback/direct-image unit followed by the proper comparison; $v$ is the image of the exceptional-adjunction counit $Ra_{\beta!}Ra_\beta^!A_s\to A_s$, evaluated at $A_s$. Thus all variable dependence occurs in $F(\tau)$.

source.place: Opening composite and the sentences describing the first and last arrows

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-cohomology-linear] with $Y=\beta$, $K=A_\beta$, $L=\omega_{\beta,A}$, $f=\tau$, and $g=\tau'$. These are objects and parallel morphisms of the finite-coefficient constructible category in the integration definition; its finite-Tor setting is a full subcategory of this category by [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. The lemma gives $F(\tau+a\tau')=F(\tau)+aF(\tau')$. It is precisely the compact-support functor of Step 1, so no identification with compact-support cohomology on a nonproper scheme is being used.

source.place: Middle-arrow sentence and its displayed equality

proof.text:
The category of $A$-modules is $A$-linear: morphism addition and scalar multiplication are pointwise, and composition distributes over both. By [lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category], its derived category $D(A)$ is $A$-linear. The bilinear composition identities in [def-weil-linear-category], applied to the fixed arrows of Step 1 and the equality in Step 2, give
$$
v\circ F(\tau+a\tau')\circ u
=v\circ F(\tau)\circ u+a\bigl(v\circ F(\tau')\circ u\bigr).
$$
Read these endomorphisms of $A$ as scalars by the integration definition (the map to $A$ sends a degree-zero $A$-endomorphism to its value on $1$); this identification preserves addition and scalar multiplication since evaluation at $1$ does. The displayed formula is therefore $\int_\beta(\tau+a\tau')=\int_\beta(\tau)+a\int_\beta(\tau')$.

source.place: Final composition sentence, with the bilinear calculation written out
